main.remarks: Denies policy evaluation when the supplied access key is not an active membership in the current access manager.

method.name: Evaluate
method.summary: Evaluate whether the supplied policy context is an active membership.
method.returns: Deny when the access key is not an active membership; otherwise allow.

method.name: EvaluateAsync
method.summary: Evaluate asynchronously whether the supplied policy context is an active membership.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous stage evaluation.
method.returns: Deny when the access key is not an active membership; otherwise allow.
